text:
emily: starting Verdant Labs RFI thread — they want an audit-ready POC showing embeddings + rerank, on-prem/private option, HSM for key custody, and 99th-pctl latency targets. deadline: next Tue. who owns matrix + security answers?

raj: I can own the capability matrix. need peak QPS and avg tokens. do we have their spreadsheet?

emily: uploaded their RFI to drive: https://drive.redwood/verdant/rfi_submit.pdf. they estimate 90 peak embed qps, 25 sustained, avg tokens 10, up to 1024 tokens for long contexts.

sam: 90 qps is doable on Hosted with caching & batching; Private will need 2x L4 or a single H100 depending on latency. POC plan: start Hosted dedicated pool -> private validation for data residency.

raj: pricing ask: monthly estimate for Hosted + one-time setup for Private (hardware + deployment) and monthly support. I'll draft rough numbers.

emily: also confirm KMS/HSM support and lead times. customer expects FIPS 140-2 HSM and customer-managed keys.

sam: Private supports customer KMS and on-prem HSM. typical provisioning lead time 3 weeks; note in RFI: "HSM provisioning for Private: estimated 3+ weeks (subject to vendor availability)."

raj: security Q: do we persist raw request payloads? need exact wording for questionnaire.

emily: suggested phrasing: `Hosted: request metadata retained 30 days; request payloads redacted by default unless customer opts in. Private: full control of retention and logging.`

sam: add graceful degradation details: if Dedicated pool saturates we can fall back to a compatible quantized model in same region, with automated routing policies. include traffic shaping config in attachments.

raj: add latency rows in matrix: embeddings 10 tokens and 1024 tokens (99th pctl). what numbers should we use?

sam: use estimates: "Embeddings 10t: 99th pctl 55ms (Hosted cached), 110ms (Private baseline)" and "Embeddings 1024t: 99th pctl 240ms (Hosted cached), 520ms (Private baseline)". mention KV cache can reduce by ~30%.

emily: legal asked about export controls for embeddings. pinging @legal-bot to confirm wording.

legal-bot: suggested answer: `Standard U.S. export control regulations apply. For restricted regimes, recommend Private deployment and legal review.`

raj: would like a short curl snippet for engineers to smoke-test embeddings during POC.

sam: adding this snippet to matrix notes:
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>" \
  -H "Idempotency-Key: smoke-001" \
  -d '{"model":"r-instruct-emb-1","input":"quick test"}'
```

emily: thanks. final checklist before I assemble RFI bundle: matrix with latency & pricing, security Q answers PDF, HSM caveat, ops runbook (network peering, KMS steps), and sample tests.

ops-bot: uploaded: https://files.redwood/cap-matrix/verdant_rfi_matrix_v1.csv and https://files.redwood/attachments/verdant_poc_runbook.pdf :thumbsup:

raj: I'll finalize the CSV and mark pricing as "estimate — subject to final sizing and contract". sending to emily by EOD today.

emily: great. we'll deliver the RFI bundle Tue morning. flag any blockers now. :pray:
